# A spatial multi-omic portrait of survival outcome for clear cell renal cell carcinoma, Meyer et al., 2026

# Figure 1 and Figure S1

Data analysis scripts for re-creating Figure 1 and Figure S1. 

# Software requirements

```{r, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
# TO DO
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(foreach)
library(ggsci)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(cytoviewer)
library(tidyverse)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(circlize)
library(cytomapper)
library(cytoviewer)
library(scran)
library(viridis)
library(conflicted)
library(corrplot)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::count)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::select)
```

# Read data

```{r}
# Available from Zenodo - DOI: TO DO
# File paths have to be adjusted by the user

## SCE objects
sce_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_tumor.rds")
sce_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_tcell.rds")
sce_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_myeloid.rds")
sce_sub_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_sub_tumor.rds")
sce_sub_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_sub_tcell.rds")
sce_sub_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_SCE_sub_myeloid.rds")

## CytoImageList objects
images_sub_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_images_sub_TU.rds")
images_sub_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_images_sub_T.rds")
images_sub_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_images_sub_MY.rds")
masks_sub_TU <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_masks_sub_TU.rds")
masks_sub_T <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_masks_sub_T.rds")
masks_sub_MY <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_masks_sub_MY.rds")

## Other
metadata_selected <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_metadata.csv")
celltype_density <- read_csv("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_celltype_density.csv")
colors <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/00_final_files/discovery_colors.rds")
```

# Figure 1

## 1B

```{r}
# Select metadata to visualize
Meta_viz <- metadata_selected %>% 
  select(PID, gender, age_bin, pT_simple, ISUP_simple, necrose, surv_data, n_images, IMC_TU_data, IMC_T_data, IMC_MY_data, HE_data, MSI_data, GEN_data)
                                         
Meta_viz <- as.data.frame(lapply(Meta_viz, as.character))
Meta_viz[is.na(Meta_viz)] <- "Unknown"
Meta_viz$n_images <- as.numeric(Meta_viz$n_images)

#Arrange
Meta_viz <- Meta_viz %>% arrange(desc(pT_simple), desc(ISUP_simple), desc(necrose))

#Heatmap annotation
sample_anno <- HeatmapAnnotation(PID = Meta_viz$PID,
                                gender = Meta_viz$gender,
                                age_bin = Meta_viz$age_bin,
                                pT_simple = Meta_viz$pT_simple,
                                ISUP_simple = Meta_viz$ISUP_simple,
                                necrose = Meta_viz$necrose,
                                surv_data = Meta_viz$surv_data,
                                IMC_TU_data = Meta_viz$IMC_TU_data,
                                IMC_T_data = Meta_viz$IMC_T_data, 
                                IMC_MY_data = Meta_viz$IMC_MY_data,
                                n_images = Meta_viz$n_images,
                                HE_data = Meta_viz$HE_data, 
                                MSI_data = Meta_viz$MSI_data,
                                GEN_data = Meta_viz$GEN_data,
                                col = colors,
                                border = T,
                                na_col = "black",
                                gap = unit(5, "points"),
                                show_annotation_name = T,
                                show_legend = c(PID = FALSE)
                                )%v%NULL

#Display plot
draw(sample_anno)
```

## 1C

```{r}
fit <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ 1, data = metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype)))

summary(fit)$table["median"]
summary(fit)$table["0.95LCL"]
summary(fit)$table["0.95UCL"]
summary(fit)$table["events"]

ggsurvplot(
  fit,
  risk.table = TRUE,
  conf.int = TRUE,
  xlab = "Time (Months)",
  ylab = "Survival probability (OS)",
  risk.table.col = "strata", 
  linetype = "strata",
  surv.median.line = "hv", 
  palette = "black",
  ggtheme = theme_classic()
)
```

## 1D 

```{r}
# T stage
fit_1 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ pT_combined, data = metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype)))

fit_p1 <- ggsurvplot(fit_1,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#ABCFE5", "#08306B"),
          conf.int = TRUE)

# ISUP grading
fit_2 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ ISUP_combined, data = metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype)))

fit_p2 <- ggsurvplot(fit_2,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          conf.int = TRUE,
          palette = c("#FC9F81", "#67000D")
)

# Necrosis
fit_3 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ necrose, data = metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype)))

fit_p3 <- ggsurvplot(fit_3,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(),
          conf.int = TRUE, 
          palette = c("#bf8cf0", "#3F007D")
)

#PDL1-like IMC score
fit_4 <- survfit(Surv(OS_months, status_OS) ~ PDL1_score, data = metadata_selected %>% filter(!is.na(survival_ecotype)))

fit_p4 <- ggsurvplot(fit_4,
          pval = TRUE,
          risk.table = TRUE, 
          risk.table.col = "strata", 
          linetype = "strata", 
          surv.median.line = "hv", 
          ggtheme = theme_classic(), 
          palette = c("#AADBAB","#00441B"),
          conf.int = TRUE
)

arrange_ggsurvplots(list(fit_p1, fit_p2, fit_p3, fit_p4), 
                    ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
```

## 1E 

```{r}
all_markers <- c(rownames(sce_MY), rownames(sce_T), rownames(sce_TU))

# Align names across panels
all_markers[all_markers == "Ir191"] <- "DNA1"
all_markers[all_markers == "Ir193"] <- "DNA2"
all_markers[all_markers == "PDL1"] <- "CD274"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD279"] <- "PD1"
all_markers[all_markers == "Tim-3"] <- "Tim3"
all_markers[all_markers == "Vim"] <- "Vimentin"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD45"] <- "CD45RO_RA"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD45RO"] <- "CD45RO_RA"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD31"] <- "CD31_vWF"
all_markers[all_markers == "CD31/vWF"] <- "CD31_vWF"
all_markers[all_markers == "clCas/PARP"] <- "clCAS_PARP"

panel_anno <- data.frame(marker = all_markers, 
                         panel = panel <- c(rep("MY",length(rownames(sce_MY))), 
                                            rep("T",length(rownames(sce_T))), 
                                            rep("TU",length(rownames(sce_TU))))
)

count <- as.data.frame(table(all_markers))
panel_anno$count <- count$Freq[match(panel_anno$marker, count$all_markers)]

panel_anno$panel_shared <- ifelse(panel_anno$count == "3", "shared", panel_anno$panel)

panel_anno_red <- panel_anno %>%
  group_by(marker) %>%
  summarise(
    count = mean(count),
    panel_combined = paste0(unique(panel), collapse = "_"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create marker categories
panel_anno_red$marker_cat <- ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("H3", "DNA1", "DNA2"), "DNA",
       ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CA9", "panCK", "VCAM1"), "Tumor_GEN",
              ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("SMA", "CD31_vWF", "Vimentin"), "Non_Immune_GEN",
                     ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("MPO", "CD3", "CD4", "CD8a", "CD20", "CD45RO_RA", "CD11c", "CD68", "CD38", "HLADR", "CD56", "CD274"), "Immune_GEN",
                            ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("TMEM173", "CD73", "IRF4", "CD44", "CXCL12", "CXCL13", "CCL19", "CCL21"), "Immunoregulatory", 
                                          ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CD16", "CD303","CD163", "DCLAMP", "CD11b", "MMP9", "CCR2", "Arginase", "CD33", "VISTA", "CD209", "CD206", "CD15", "IDO1"), "Myeloid_SPE", 
                                                 ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("GATA3", "4-1BB", "CD45RA", "LAG-3", "PD1", "CD7", "GranB", "EOMES", "FOXP3", "CD278", "GITR", "CD134", "Tbet", "NKG2A", "GranK", "Tim3"), "Tcell_SPE", 
                                                        ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("GPX4", "PDK4", "PKM2", "IDH2", "GLUT1", "Fumarase", "GLUD1_2", "S6")
, "Tumor_Metabolism_SPE", 
ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("HIF1a", "CD140b", "BRG1", "HIF2a", "VEGFR1", "VHL"), "Tumor_Hypoxia_Angio_SPE", 
       ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("NFKB", "p53", "MYC", "EGFR", "RB1", "mTOR", "CyclinD1"), "Tumor_Oncogenic_SPE", 
              ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("CD44", "ICAM1", "CD10", "AuroraKinaseA"), "Tumor_Other_SPE",
                     ifelse(panel_anno_red$marker %in% c("clCAS_PARP", "Ki67"), "State", NA))))))))))))

# Create colors
col <- list(panel = setNames(c("black","#929882","#ba8874","#596db4", "#F2B342", "#317EC2", "#825CA6"), 
                             c("MY_T_TU", "MY_T", "MY_TU", "T_TU", "MY", "T", "TU")),
            cat = setNames(c("#33A02C", "#B2DF8A", "#A6CEE3","#FDBF6F", "#B15928", "#1F78B4","#FFFF99","#6A3D9A",  "#E31A1C", "#CAB2D6", "#FB9A99", "#FF7F00"),
                           c("DNA", "State", "Immune_GEN", "Immunoregulatory", "Non_Immune_GEN", "Tcell_SPE", "Myeloid_SPE", "Tumor_GEN", "Tumor_Hypoxia_Angio_SPE", "Tumor_Metabolism_SPE", "Tumor_Oncogenic_SPE", "Tumor_Other_SPE"
)),
count = colorRamp2(c(min(panel_anno_red$count),max(panel_anno_red$count)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Greys")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Greys")[3]))
)

panel_anno_red <- panel_anno_red %>% arrange(-count, panel_combined, marker_cat)

# Plot
HeatmapAnnotation(count = panel_anno_red$count,
                  cat = panel_anno_red$marker_cat,
                  panel = panel_anno_red$panel_combined,
                  marker = anno_text(panel_anno_red$marker),
                  col = col,
                  border = T,
                  na_col = "black",
                  gap = unit(5, "points"),
                  show_annotation_name = T)%v%NULL
```

# Figure S1

## S1A 

IMC images, masks and metadata can be viewed and downloaded using 
[cytoviewer](https://github.com/BodenmillerGroup/cytoviewer) (v1.13.3). An image and 
mask subset from 50 patients corresponding to around 100 images in form of 
`CytoImageList` objects is provided directly on Zenodo. For full dataset 
access, please process the raw data. 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Tumor panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_TU, 
           mask = masks_sub_TU, 
           object = sce_sub_TU, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))

# Myeloid panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_MY, 
           mask = masks_sub_MY, 
           object = sce_sub_MY, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))


# T cell panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_T, 
           mask = masks_sub_T, 
           object = sce_sub_T, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))
```

## S1B 

```{r}
### 1. Heatmap body
# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce_MY <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_MY, ids = sce_MY$analysis_cat,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_MY)$broad_cluster)

### 2. Heatmap annotation
## 2.1 Spatial features
spatial <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, analysis_cat)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-analysis_cat) %>% aggregate(by = list(analysis_cat = spatial$analysis_cat), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("analysis_cat")

area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))

ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

## 2.2 Metadata features
# Number of cells per analysis_cat 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(analysis_cat, ncells)

# Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(analysis_cat) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(analysis_cat) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("analysis_cat")

# GMM - non-epithelial GMM
nr_immune <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(analysis_cat, non_epithelial_GMM) %>% table()
fr_immune <- as.data.frame(nr_immune) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = non_epithelial_GMM, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("analysis_cat")
fr_immune <- fr_immune %>% transmute(fr_immune = `TRUE`/rowSums(fr_immune)) %>% as.data.frame()

# Astir - non-epithelial prediction
nr_astir <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(analysis_cat, astir_combined) %>% table()
fr_astir <- as.data.frame(nr_astir) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = astir_combined, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("analysis_cat")
fr_astir <- fr_astir %>% select(-"Unknown/Other") %>% transmute(fr_astir = `Non-Epithelial`/rowSums(fr_astir)) %>% as.data.frame()

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(GMM_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_immune, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            Astir_NonEpi = anno_barplot(fr_astir, width = unit(12, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),
                            n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")


### 3. Plot
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce_MY, "min_max")),
        col = viridis(100),
        name= "min_max",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

draw(h)
```

## S1C 


```{r}
### 1. Heatmap body 
# Aggregrate across cells with the mean
mean_sce_MY <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce_MY, ids = sce_MY$immune_metacluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce_MY)$immune_cluster_channel)

### 2. Heatmap annotation 
## 2.1 Spatial features
spatial <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,n_neighbors, immune_metacluster)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-immune_metacluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(immune_metacluster = spatial$immune_metacluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

area_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3]))
eccentricity_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity),median(spatial$eccentricity),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Purples")[3]))
n_neighbors_col <- colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors),median(spatial$n_neighbors),max(spatial$n_neighbors)), c(brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[1],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[2],brewer.pal(3,"RdPu")[3]))

ha_spatial <- HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$area,
               eccentricity = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$eccentricity,
               n_neighbors = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$n_neighbors),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

## 2.2 Predictions
# Astir cell types
astir_anno <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,astir_immune_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
astir_anno <- astir_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = astir_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

# GMM cell types
GMM_anno <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,GMM_immune_combined) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% mutate(fra = Freq/sum(Freq)) 
GMM_anno <- GMM_anno %>% select(-Freq) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = immune_metacluster,names_from = GMM_immune_combined,values_from = fra) %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

ha_astir_GMM <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  astir_immune_combined = anno_barplot(astir_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$astir_col)),
  GMM_immune_combined = anno_barplot(GMM_anno, width = unit(20, "mm"), gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$GMM_col)),
                            border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(3,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

## 2.3 Metadata features
# Number of cells 
n_cells <- colData(mean_sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(immune_metacluster, ncells)

# Number of contributing patients (at least 5 cells)
cluster_PID <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(immune_metacluster,PID) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
n_PID <- cluster_PID %>% filter(Freq>5) %>% group_by(immune_metacluster) %>% count(name = "n_PID") %>% column_to_rownames("immune_metacluster")

ha_meta <- HeatmapAnnotation(n_cells = anno_barplot(n_cells$ncells, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),                        n_PID = anno_barplot(n_PID$n_PID, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#440154FF", col = 1)),
                             border = TRUE, 
                            annotation_name_rot = 90,
                            gap = unit(1,"mm"),
                            which = "row")

### 3. Annotation dataframe
anno <- colData(mean_sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(immune_metacluster, ncells)

anno$immune_cat <- ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster %in% c("Stromal","Endothelial"), "Stromal", 
       ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster == "Unknown_Other", "Undefined", 
              ifelse(anno$immune_metacluster %in% c("Macrophage", "Neutrophil"), "Macrophage", "Lymphoid")))


### 4. Plot
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce_MY, "min_max")),
        col = viridis(100),
        name = "min_max",
        show_row_names = T, 
        row_names_side = "left",
        show_column_names =  T, 
        row_split = anno$immune_cat,
        cluster_row_slices = FALSE,
        row_title = NULL,
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2"
        )+
  ha_astir_GMM+
  ha_spatial+
  ha_meta

# Create legends for annotation 
lgd <- Legend(title = "Immune metacluster", at = names(metadata(sce_MY)$colors$immune_metacluster), 
              legend_gp = gpar(fill = metadata(sce_MY)$colors$immune_metacluster))

# Draw heatmap
draw(h, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```

## S1D 

```{r}
# Myeloid
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_MY) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_MY = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_MY)

# Add others
## T cell
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_T) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
T_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_T = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_T)

## Tumor
PID_analysis_cat <- colData(sce_TU) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(analysis_cat,PID) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
PID_area <- colData(sce_TU) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(tissue_area,PID) %>% unique() %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(mean_tissue_area = mean(tissue_area))
PID_analysis_cat$mean_tissue_area <- PID_area$mean_tissue_area[match(PID_analysis_cat$PID, PID_area$PID)]
TU_analysis_cat <- PID_analysis_cat %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(density_tumor_TU = Freq/(mean_tissue_area/1000000)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor") %>% select(PID, density_tumor_TU)

MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_T <- T_analysis_cat$density_tumor_T[match(MY_analysis_cat$PID, T_analysis_cat$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat$density_tumor_TU <- TU_analysis_cat$density_tumor_TU[match(MY_analysis_cat$PID, TU_analysis_cat$PID)]
MY_analysis_cat <- MY_analysis_cat[complete.cases(MY_analysis_cat),]

# Plot
cor_sce <- MY_analysis_cat %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% as.data.frame

corrplot(cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman"), method="color", col=brewer.pal(n=8, name="RdBu"),  
         type="upper", order="hclust",hclust.method = "ward.D2", 
         addCoef.col = "black", addCoefasPercent = F,
         tl.col="black", tl.srt=40,
         diag=F
)
```

## S1E 

```{r}
# Per celltype
celltype_density <- celltype_density %>% filter(!celltype_combined_broad %in% c("Unknown_Other", "tumor"))

out_cor <- foreach(i = unique(celltype_density$celltype_combined_broad), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
cor_sce <- celltype_density %>% filter(celltype_combined_broad == i) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = 2,names_from = panel, values_from = density) %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% as.data.frame
cor_sce <- cor_sce[complete.cases(cor_sce),]
cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman")
cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique()
data.frame(immune_metacluster = i, 
           cor = cor_out[cor_out !=1] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "celltype")
}

general_dens_out <- celltype_density %>% group_by(celltype_combined_broad) %>% summarise(density = mean(density, na.rm = TRUE))
out_cor$density_general <- general_dens_out$density[match(out_cor$immune_metacluster, general_dens_out$celltype_combined_broad)]

# Plot
ggplot(out_cor, aes(x = reorder(immune_metacluster,-cor), y = cor))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = immune_metacluster, size = density_general))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce_MY)$colors$immune_metacluster)+
  ylab("SCC")+
  xlab("Per celltype")+
  theme_classic()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean SCC = ",round(mean(out_cor$cor), digits = 3)))
```


## S1F

```{r}
# Per patient
PID_cor <- foreach(i = unique(celltype_density$PID), .combine = "rbind")%do%{
cor_sce <- celltype_density %>% filter(PID == i) %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = 1, names_from = panel, values_from = density) %>% column_to_rownames("celltype_combined_broad") %>% as.data.frame
cor_sce <- cor_sce[complete.cases(cor_sce),]
cor_out <- cor(cor_sce,method = "spearman")
diag(cor_out) <- NA
data.frame(PID = i, 
           cor = cor_out[upper.tri(cor_out)] %>% as.numeric() %>% unique(), 
           category = "PID")
}

PID_cor_out <- PID_cor %>% group_by(PID) %>% summarize(cor_mean = mean(cor, na.rm = TRUE), category = "PID")

# Plot
ggplot(PID_cor_out, aes(x = category, y = cor_mean))+  
  geom_point(aes(color = PID))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.colour = NA, alpha = 0.8)+
  scale_color_manual(values=metadata(sce_MY)$colors$PID)+
  guides(color = "none")+
  ylab("SCC")+
  xlab("Per PID")+
  theme_classic()+
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1))+
  ggtitle(paste("Mean SCC = ",round(mean(PID_cor$cor, na.rm = TRUE), digits = 2)))
```

## S1G

IMC images, masks and metadata can be viewed and downloaded using 
[cytoviewer](https://github.com/BodenmillerGroup/cytoviewer) (v1.13.3). An image and 
mask subset from 50 patients corresponding to around 100 images in form of 
`CytoImageList` objects is provided directly on Zenodo. For full dataset 
access, please process the raw data. 

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Tumor panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_TU, 
           mask = masks_sub_TU, 
           object = sce_sub_TU, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))

# Myeloid panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_MY, 
           mask = masks_sub_MY, 
           object = sce_sub_MY, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))


# T cell panel data
cytoviewer(image = images_sub_T, 
           mask = masks_sub_T, 
           object = sce_sub_T, 
           img_id = "sample_id", 
           cell_id = "ObjectNumber", 
           coords = c("Pos_X", "Pos_Y"))
```
